segment_captions.caption: C holds a banana peel while baby eats a banana slice from the peel.

C holds a banana peel with both hands, then brings it closer to their mouth. The banana peel is partially peeled, revealing the fruit inside. C's expression changes from focused to slightly surprised as they look at the banana peel.
C holds a banana with both hands, peeling it slightly while looking around the room.
